lines: 大唐垂拱四年（公元688年），洛州合宫县突降大雨，城郊小驿所外面“咣当！咣当！”传来急促的敲门声，老阍人态度有几分不耐，嚷嚷道：“来了，来了！”
他慢慢走过去打开门闩，斑驳的杉木门发出刺耳的“咯吱”声，门打开，门口立着一名十八九岁的年轻人，短疵发，衣着古怪，似胡服却无袖，脚上踩着怪异的马靴，浑身湿透，淋得像落汤鸡一般，他见到了老阍人，立刻拱手行礼：“老丈，有礼了！”
年轻人一开口倒是一口地道的洛州官话，老阍人的神色略微松弛了一些，却依旧很严肃，他眼睛盯着年轻人，似乎能把其看穿一般，年轻人的笑容立刻变得有些僵硬了！
“可有公验？”老阍人冷冰冰的道。
“呃……有！有的！”年轻人连忙从怀里掏出一信封大小的纸片，小心翼翼的递了过去。
老阍人将东西接在手中，认真瞧着：“岳二郎……”
老阍人眼睛有些不好使，识字似乎也不多，但他那股认真堪合的劲儿，却让年轻人心中真的很紧张。
年轻人叫岳峰，这“公验”对他来说可不真，因为他根本就不是公验上写的那个“岳二郎”，他的真实身份其实是一名现代特种兵。
部队搞野外生存训练，他在丛林中迷路，一不小心跌进了深渊，醒来的时候他便被一众身穿唐装的陌生人围着，其中有一名面容慈祥的老妇人抱着他哭得很伤心。
现在他知道了，老妇人是他的母亲，另外还有他的哥哥和嫂子，他家里还有个妹妹两年前被选秀进了洛阳紫微宫，一直没有了消息。
不错，岳峰就这样稀里糊涂的穿越成了岳二郎，而且穿越的当天便被临时征召徭役，按照大唐《均田法》男丁赋税是“租调庸”制，“租”就是田租，“调”便是要给朝廷交纳地方特产，一般是绢，布，麻，而“庸”便是服役，每名男丁每年需要为国家服役二十天。
按照大唐的律令，男子二十一为丁，岳峰今年刚刚十八岁，只算是中男，原则上他还不需要服役，但是这一次是特招。
按照律令，像岳峰这种情况，倘若被征召满二十日，则可以免除一户租调，也就是说岳峰倘若完成了役期，他家今年的田租和布匹丝绸的赋税都可以获得减免，对普通农家来说，这绝对是一件大好事，因此阿母虽然舍不得岳峰，却还是咬牙让岳峰来服役……
“无知田舍儿，这里也是你能入的么？”老阍人忽然叱喝道，他将手中的“公验”摔在了岳峰的面前，满脸都是鄙夷之色。
岳峰瞬间尴尬了，原来驿所驿站只有官员才能入，岳峰的“公验”上将他的来历身份写得清清楚楚，他区区一平民，就算是被征召服役，也没有资格进驿所，大唐的森严等级给岳峰泼了一盆冷水。
外面滂沱大雨，而且天色也渐渐的黑了，岳峰倘若没有地方歇息，今晚真就只能在风雨中过夜了，正在为难的时候，驿所里面传来一声长笑：“阿爷，让他进来吧！这年头，大家都不容易，赶明儿咱能多一帮手也好呢！”
老阍人这才让开了半面身子，面色依旧严肃道：“看在几名武侯的面子上让你暂歇一晚，休得喧哗，休得惹事生非，否则严惩不饶！”
岳峰大喜过望，连连称谢，进入了驿所，他便看到有四个人围着一个大火盆饶有兴致的在说话。
看这几人，都穿着玄色的窄袖胡服，头戴青色幞头，腰上还带着刀，果然是几个武侯不良人。唐代的武侯又称不良人，相当于片警一类维护治安的小吏，他们的地位并不高，比岳峰这种“田舍儿”也就强一丁点儿。
岳峰上前和他们一一见礼，几个人倒是很热情，给岳峰让了位子，又嚷嚷着让驿所的老阍人给岳峰煮了一碗“馎饦”，其实就是面片儿汤，岳峰趁热囫囵吞枣将“馎饦”吃下肚去，才终于感觉满血复活了。
“你们知道吗？最近洛州又有祥瑞，据说有一块天生白壁上生有‘圣母临人，永昌帝业’八个大字，你们说奇怪不奇怪？据说此乃天授圣图，预示着天后将要君临天下呢……”
岳峰心中“咯噔”一下，看向说话之人，这人约莫二十岁的样子，五短身材，其貌不扬，一双眼珠子特别灵活，给人短小精悍之感。这小子姓朱，叫朱恩。
他说的这祥瑞怎么听起来这么耳熟呢？岳峰脑子里念头转动，忽然灵光一闪，想到历史上女皇武则天登基之前，武承嗣献瑞造势不就是找了一块白石头，让人在上面刻了字，而且还用“紫石杂药”装饰起来，让人献给武则天，为武则天称帝做铺垫么？
一念及此，岳峰浑身汗毛都竖起来了，他瞬间意识到自己穿越过来的这个时候竟然是唐朝最混乱，最复杂，最危险也是最动荡的时候。
武氏欲称帝，为了扫平李唐的阻力，她广兴酷吏，大开杀戒，满朝文武都在酷吏的“罗织”诬告中人人自危，在这个过程中朝廷中书，门下、尚书等省的宰相几乎被杀光，而李唐宗室被杀的各路王爷，更是多达一百多人，其中被牵连的人更是不计其数。
也就是说，当今朝廷从上到下各级官员，在接下来几年的时间内几乎要全部换一遍，而那些被换掉的官员要么被酷吏整死，要么被杀，能够被贬斥流放都算是最幸运的了！酷吏政治笼罩下的大唐朝堂，马上就会完全乱套，一场腥风血雨立刻就要到来了。
岳峰现在所在的合宫县就靠近东都洛阳，难怪感觉律令如此森严，原来是武则天正在紧锣密鼓的准备登基，洛州自然需要保持绝对的稳定！
“天后君临天下是大势所趋，人心所向，据说现在各州都有士子百姓准备给朝廷上书，催天后登基呢！”另外又有一个不良人道。
这几个人围着火炉，侃侃而谈，那个叫朱恩的又道：“可是有些人却妄图逆天而行，最近洛州传来消息，说是太子舍人郝象贤谋反，临刑之时竟然口出妄言，揭发后宫的隐慝，真是榆木老朽，活该被砍头……”
他顿了顿，又道：“哥儿注意一下，据说这郝象贤案牵连极广，近期从京中外逃的‘浮逃’极多，这些人我们碰上了倘若能抓住，那可是大功劳！兴许我们未来的荣华富贵就在这些人身上呢！”
“呵呵，朱四郎你想得倒挺美，大功劳哪里那么好揽，斩一头，获钱十贯。获一生，另赏绢三匹！啧啧，朱四郎，你可曾斩过人头？”
“哄！”众人一阵哄笑，气氛更加热烈，老阍人阴沉着脸凑过来道：“不良人等肃静！休得扰驿舍里的大人清净！”
几个不良人这才收敛，这时驿所里面传来了几声咳嗽，隐隐绰绰依稀能看到一位老大人正在驿所里读书，瞧其一袭青袍，头戴软脚幞头，当是一名官员无疑。
大唐官和吏之间等级颇严，不良人这种小吏原本是没有资格住驿所，也是最近特殊情况，驿所也比较空闲，他们才临时被安排在这边歇脚。
担心扰贵人清净，几名不良人便按住了话头，恰时天色已暗了，大家也都辛苦忙碌了一天，因而便都围着火炉和衣歇息，一会儿功夫，几个人竟然都沉沉睡去了。
content_en:
In the fourth year of Chui Gong of the Tang Dynasty (AD 688), heavy rain suddenly fell in Hegong County, Luozhou. "Bang bang! Bang bang!" came the hurried knock on the door outside the small post office on the outskirts of the city. Lao Yan was a little impatient and shouted: "It's coming, it's coming!"
He slowly walked over and opened the door latch, and the mottled fir door made a harsh "creak" sound. The door opened, and a young man of eighteen or nineteen years old stood at the door. He had short bald hair, strange clothes, like a Hufu but sleeveless, and strange riding boots on his feet. He was soaked all over, like a drowned rat. When he saw the old man, he immediately raised his hands and saluted: "Old man, you are polite!"
The young man spoke authentic Luozhou Mandarin when he spoke. Lao Yan's expression relaxed a little, but he was still very serious. He stared at the young man, as if he could see through him, and the young man's smile immediately became a little stiff!
"Is there any public inspection?" Lao Yan said coldly.
"Uh... Yes! Yes!" The young man quickly took out an envelope-sized piece of paper from his arms and handed it over carefully.
Lao Yan took the thing in his hand and looked at it carefully: "Yue Erlang..."
Lao Yan's eyesight was a bit awkward and he didn't seem to be very literate, but his seriousness made the young man really nervous.
The young man's name is Yue Feng. This "official test" is not true for him, because he is not the "Yue Erlang" written on the official test at all. His true identity is actually a modern special forces soldier.
The army was engaged in wilderness survival training. He got lost in the jungle and accidentally fell into an abyss. When he woke up, he was surrounded by a group of strangers in Tang suits. Among them was an old woman with a kind face who hugged him and cried sadly.
Now he knows that the old woman is his mother, as well as his brother and sister-in-law. There is also a younger sister in his family who was drafted into Luoyang Ziwei Palace two years ago, but there has been no news.
Yes, Yue Feng inexplicably traveled through time and became Yue Erlang, and was temporarily called into service on the day he crossed over. According to the Tang Dynasty's "Law of Equalizing Land", male taxation was a "rent and transfer" system. "Rent" refers to land rent, "tiao" means paying local specialties to the court, usually silk, cloth, and linen, and "yong" means service. Each male is required to serve the country for twenty days every year.
According to the laws of the Tang Dynasty, a man aged twenty-one is a Ding. Yue Feng is just eighteen years old this year and is only considered a middle-aged man. In principle, he does not need to serve, but this time he is a special recruit.
According to the law, if Yue Feng is recruited for twenty days, one household can be exempted from rent transfer. In other words, if Yue Feng completes his term of service, his family's field rent and cloth and silk taxes this year can be exempted or exempted. For ordinary farmers, this is definitely a good thing. Therefore, although my mother was reluctant to part with Yue Feng, she still gritted her teeth and let Yue Feng serve...
"Ignorant Farmer, are you allowed to enter this place?" Lao Yan suddenly shouted. He threw the "Public Examination" in his hand in front of Yue Feng, with a look of disdain on his face.
Yue Feng was instantly embarrassed. It turned out that only officials could enter the post office. Yue Feng's "public inspection" clearly stated his origin and identity. Even if he was a mere civilian, he was not qualified to enter the post office even if he was recruited to serve. The strict hierarchy of the Tang Dynasty poured cold water on Yue Feng.
It is raining heavily outside, and the sky is gradually getting dark. If Yue Feng has no place to rest, he will really have to spend the night in the wind and rain tonight. When he is in trouble, a long laugh comes from inside the post: "Grandpa, let him in! It's not easy for everyone these days, it would be great if we could have more help tomorrow!"
Only then did Lao Yan move half of his body away, his face still serious as he said: "For the sake of the few Wuhous, I'll let you rest for one night. Don't make noises or cause trouble, otherwise you will be severely punished!"
Yue Feng was overjoyed and thanked him repeatedly. After entering the inn, he saw four people talking with interest around a large brazier.
Looking at these people, they are all wearing black narrow-sleeved Hu clothes, wearing green turbans on their heads, and carrying knives on their waists. They are indeed some of Wuhou's bad guys. Wuhou in the Tang Dynasty was also called a bad person, who was equivalent to a small official who maintained law and order, such as a policeman. Their status was not high, and they were only a little bit better than "farmers" like Yue Feng.
Yue Feng stepped forward to greet them one by one. Some of them were very enthusiastic and gave up their seats to Yue Feng. They also asked the old man of the post to cook a bowl of "fufu" for Yue Feng. It was actually noodle soup. Yue Feng swallowed the "fufu" while it was hot, and finally felt full of blood and resurrected.
"Do you know? There has been auspiciousness in Luozhou recently. It is said that there is a natural white wall with the eight characters 'The Holy Mother is here, Yongchang is the emperor'. Do you think it is strange? It is said that this is a sacred picture given by heaven, which indicates that the Queen of Heaven will rule the world..."
Yue Feng's heart skipped a beat and he looked at the person who was speaking. He was about twenty years old, with a short stature and an unattractive appearance. His eyes were particularly flexible, giving him the impression of being short and capable. This guy’s surname is Zhu and his name is Zhu En.
Why does the auspiciousness he mentioned sound so familiar? Yue Feng's thoughts were spinning in his mind, and suddenly he had a flash of inspiration. He thought that before Empress Wu Zetian ascended the throne in history, didn't Wu Chengsi find a white stone, have someone carve words on it, and decorate it with "Purple Stone Miscellaneous Medicine" to present it to Wu Zetian and pave the way for Wu Zetian to become emperor?
Thinking of this, the hairs on Yue Feng's whole body stood up. He instantly realized that the time he traveled through was actually the most chaotic, complex, dangerous and turbulent time in the Tang Dynasty.
The Wu family wanted to become emperor, but in order to eliminate Li Tang's resistance, she promoted cruel officials and went on a killing spree. Everyone in the civil and military dynasties was in danger because of the false accusations of "Luo Zhi" by the cruel officials. In the process, almost all the prime ministers of the imperial court, menxia, ​​ministers and other provinces were killed. More than 100 princes from all walks of life in the Li Tang clan were killed, and countless people were implicated.
In other words, almost all officials from top to bottom in the current imperial court will be replaced in the next few years, and those officials who are replaced will either be tortured to death by cruel officials or killed. They are considered the luckiest to be reprimanded and exiled! The Tang Dynasty, shrouded in ruthless official politics, will soon be completely in chaos, and a bloody storm will soon come.
Hegong County, where Yue Feng is currently located, is close to the eastern capital Luoyang. No wonder the laws and regulations feel so strict. It turns out that Wu Zetian is busy preparing to ascend the throne, so Luozhou naturally needs to maintain absolute stability!
"It is the general trend of the times and the will of the people for the Queen of Heaven to rule the world. It is said that scholars and common people in all states are preparing to write letters to the court to urge the Queen of Heaven to ascend the throne!" Another bad person said.
These people were chatting around the stove, and the one named Zhu En added: "But some people are trying to go against heaven. Recently, news came from Luozhou that the prince's wife, Hao Xiangxian, was plotting a rebellion. When he was about to be executed, he actually spoke lies and exposed the secrets of the harem. He is really an old elm and deserves to be beheaded..."
He paused and then said: "Brother, please pay attention. It is said that the Hao Xiangxian case is very involved. There have been many 'fleeing' people fleeing from Beijing recently. If we can catch these people, it will be a great achievement! Maybe our future glory and wealth will lie with these people!"
"Haha, Zhu Silang, you have a beautiful idea. It's so easy to get a big credit. If you behead a head, you will get ten pieces of money. If you get a lifetime, you will also be rewarded with three pieces of silk! Tsk, Zhu Silang, have you ever beheaded a human being?"
"Coax!" Everyone burst into laughter, and the atmosphere became more lively. The old man came over with a gloomy face and said: "Silence, you bad people! Don't disturb the purity of the adults in the post!"
Only then did the bad guys restrain themselves. At this time, there were several coughs in the post, and an old man could be vaguely seen studying in the post. He was wearing a green robe and a soft-legged headdress. He was undoubtedly an official.
The hierarchy between officials and officials in the Tang Dynasty was very strict. Small officials like bad guys were not qualified to live in the post house. Due to the recent special circumstances, the post house was relatively free, so they were temporarily arranged to rest here.
Worried about disturbing the noble's purity, the bad guys kept their words. It was already getting dark and everyone had been working hard all day, so they all gathered around the stove and took a rest in their clothes. After a while, several people fell asleep.
